note: Foothills lake recreation area 33 km south of Rocky Mountain House on Hwy 22 and 7 km west on Hwy 591. Most sites are open and face Phyllis Lake; boat launch, electric motors only, and a fish-cleaning station. No firewood for sale. --Claude
summary: AP page read: 21 unserviced FCFS sites, C$28, season May 14 - Sep 21 (was approx. May 15 - Sep 30), pump water not potable, no firewood; lakeview confirmed (agency: 'most ... open and face the lake'; imagery shows a tree strip between road-side sites and shore); phone -> 403-845-8349.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview; confirmed, no upgrade): the agency says 'most of which are open and face the lake'. On imagery the campground road runs north-south along the east shore; the sites on its west side are ~45-55 m from the water with a 20-40 m strip of spruce between, so a filtered lake view at most. At the north end of the road a small grassy clearing slopes to the shore (~20-35 m from water, scattered trees) with a structure in it; I cannot tell from imagery or any agency map whether it holds RV sites or is day use, and there is no site map or site numbers anywhere, so no upgrade is proposed. The south end is the boat launch and its turnaround.

PHONE: stored 403-845-8309 is the number the page gives for second-unit questions ('contact Rocky Mountain House at (403) 845-8309'); the campground's 'Information:' line is '(403) 845-8349 Rocky District Office'. Recommend 403-845-8349. No 'Facility Operator' line.
SENIORS LINE: absent on this page.

STATUS: advisory 'Operational Service Change - Winter Seasonal Operations' effective September 21, 2026: 'The campground is not open for overnight camping ... welcoming campers back in May 2027.' Ordinary end of season; no status written.
WEBSITE: stored URL is this campground's camping page (200). Not on shop.albertaparks.ca (FCFS).

PIN (52.10082,-114.96415): at the north end of the campground road; the AP directions point (52.098881,-114.9644) is the south end by the boat launch, ~215 m away. The sites lie between them; the pin is within ~120 m of the middle. Within tolerance.
